name: Earth
fact: Every human who has ever lived did so here. The reference orbit by which all others are measured.
bio: The 23.44° axial tilt creates the seasons — not distance from the Sun. Earth is actually closer to the Sun in January than July.

science_sections.why: The astronomical unit IS the Earth-Sun mean distance — Earth is the literal yardstick for every solar-system measurement.
Earth's orbit defines the ecliptic plane. Every other planet's inclination is measured relative to this reference.
Earth's 23.4° tilt is the textbook seasons-machine — equinoxes and solstices arise directly from the angle between rotation axis and orbital plane.
Every Mars launch window — every 26 months — is an Earth-departure Hohmann transfer. The ladder leaves from here.
The Moon is unusually large for its parent — the ratio (diameter ≈ 0.27 of Earth) is the highest in any planet–satellite pair.
